latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of OpenClaw — AI Legal Assistant for Indian Advocates.

- Provides automated drafting for Indian legal documents, including notices, plaints, bail applications, affidavits, petitions, and more.
- Supports research on Indian statutes (including post-2024 BNS/BNSS/BSA reform), case law, and procedural queries with dual-citation.
- Assists with practice management: client intake, cause lists, court diaries, legal memos, and fee notes.
- Handles uploaded case files and court documents with structured case briefing and next-step suggestions.
- Built-in privacy safeguards, information redaction, and professional Indian legal formatting standards throughout.
